title: Smells fantastic! Pretty design
text:
Smells fantastic! Pretty design. I love the scent of this candle. The only thing that stops it from getting 5 stars is the logo. If they would have put the "yankee candle" label at the bottom or on the back side. The flower design on the front, is very pretty, but the logo is right in the center of it.

I love that the top doubles as a candle holder. Nice idea!

product_metadata.title: Yankee Candle Elevation Collection with Platform Lid Velvet Woods Scented Candle, Large 2-Wick, 80 Hour Burn Time
features: Velvet Woods is a stroll through rich woods teeming with exotic interludes of warm amber and a hint of sweet fruit blossoms
This decor candle features soft corners and an updated silhouette—perfect for showcasing your style in any room
19.5 oz. candle burn time: 65 to 80 hours
Brushed metal lid fits nicely under the candle to create a pedestal
Premium-grade colored soy-blend wax delivers a clean, consistent burn
description: Styled with a unique and contemporary silhouette, the Yankee Candle Elevation Collection with Platform Lid features a specially designed lid that securely fits into the bottom of the glass, acting as a pedestal and creating a unified look. The collection balances high-quality glass and minimalist lines, resulting in a distinct shape that complements the style of any home. A smooth soy wax blend and fresh, layered fragrances lead to an enjoyable, room-filling experience.
Fragrance Notes: Top: Velvet Accord. Mid: Tobacco Flower, Blackberry Merlot, Orchid. Base: Ebony Woods, Amber
